trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Zero-sized dimensions in mean/std tensors that require broadcasting
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Empty tensors with at least one zero-sized dimension and mismatched broadcast shapes, e.g., mean shape (0,2) and std shape (0,1).

bug_oracle.description: torch.normal raises an exception when called with zero-sized mean and std tensors whose shapes require broadcasting.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Mutate tensor shapes to introduce zero-sized dimensions while varying broadcast compatibility.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Generate empty and zero-sized mean/std tensor pairs with different broadcastable and non-broadcastable shapes.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Inject shape constraints covering zero-sized tensor broadcasting cases.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Call torch.normal with the generated mean/std tensor pairs.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Use broadcasting semantics as reference; detect crashes, unexpected exceptions, or inconsistencies in exception behavior.
